limitations: A title-screen resource reload does not verify every placed block, world compatibility or server authentication.

Yuushya collision generation logs three slab_cube_yellow_wool read messages because ModelReader cannot resolve the vanilla cube_column parent. That model exists in Minecraft; the slab, half-slab and snow-layer blocks compute their shapes in their block classes instead of using this generated collision data.
Macaw grass-topped walls are excluded through the official non_diagonal_fences tag. Diagonal Blocks may still warn because its diagnostic reads a fixed internal list.
Missing CityCraft private/test artwork uses explicitly documented vanilla fallback resources.

Measurements are individual local runs, not hardware-independent performance guarantees. Both final comparison runs retain active user applications and memory pressure; prior baseline measurements are also preserved to show this variation.
